
# store 1 in x2
01011000 00000000 00000000 010 00010 # pc relative load the command thats 2 down into x2
000101 00 00000000 00000000 00000011 # branch past the number (low high)
00000000000000000000000000000001 # the number 1 low
00000000000000000000000000000000 # the number 1 high

# store 0 in x4
11001011 001 00010 011000 00010 00100

# pc relative load our second last command into x3
01011000 00000000 00000000 100 00011 # PC relative load add command to x3

# math operations
11001011 001 00010 011000 00011 00011 # x3 = x3 - x2
10001011 001 00000 011000 00011 00011 # x3 = x3 + x0

# store register x3 into the original memory slot
11111000 000 00010 0100 00 00 100 00011

# end of program
10001011 001 11111 011000 00001 00001 # add xzr to x1
11010110000111110000001111000000 # end the program
